## [1.0.2](https://github.com/Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (2026-07-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* bypass AllowlistManager partner checks and rewrite Waze SDK reverse-bind package on YT Music ([50989a6](https://github.com/Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch/commit/50989a66d2a3d3b5f2054ddb77126d1096e15266))
* disable backmerge to non-existent dev branch [skip ci] ([c07b32d](https://github.com/Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch/commit/c07b32dfea84db6f1df70431ae54396069f3f9e6))

patches.name: Waze compatibility (MicroG)
patches.description: Fixes crash when Waze tries to connect via MediaBrowserService on MicroG devices.

patches.name: Waze GmsCore support
patches.description: Redirects GMS calls to MicroG (app.revanced.android.gms) and enables Google account sign-in.

patches.name: Waze Morphe Music bytecode
patches.description: Injects Morphe Music into Waze audio SDK app list.

patches.name: Waze Morphe Music support
patches.description: Adds Morphe Music (app.morphe.android.apps.youtube.music) to Waze audio SDK.
